text:
sam: FYI billing-preview shows some routes with NEGATIVE effective per-token cost after we enabled sticky-routing+session-slab amortization last night. Not a UI bug  appears in the econ backend.

mona: what does negative mean here? like credits > spend?

sam: exactly. for a few low-volume routes, amortized cache credits > measured token spending so unit cost becomes negative in preview.

ria: I pulled logs. The amortization window is 1h; session_slab credits are distributed at session end. router change started reusing session_id across retries leading to double-issuing slab credits for the same session_id.

keith: ahh we added retry short-circuiting on the edge to reduce latency which replays the session header. didn't think about session-end bookkeeping.

mona: that explains negative values. Ops question: how bad on invoices? this is currently only in billing-preview, not final invoices.

sam: preview only for now. but product wants to avoid user confusion when prefilling invoices.

ria: two immediate mitigations: 1) tighten invariants in the aggregator to dedupe session_slab credits by (session_id, slab_key, window_start); 2) change preview to cap per-route credit to 100% of token spend unless opt-in. both behind FFs.

keith: I'll patch the router to stop reusing session_id on retries (edge-change). low risk canary.

mona: UX: add an explanatory badge on billing-preview rows that have capped credits: "CAPPED: fallback applied" with link to explanation. product wants the preview to reflect safest view by default.

sam: agree. Also record an audit flag on aggregated rows: `credit_deduped:true|false` and `credit_cap_applied:true|false` so we can trace adjustments.

ria: small SQL dedupe I tested:
```
WITH credits AS (
  SELECT session_id, slab_key, min(received_at) as t, sum(credit) as credit
  FROM slab_events
  WHERE received_at BETWEEN $start AND $end
  GROUP BY session_id, slab_key
)
SELECT slab_key, sum(credit) FROM credits GROUP BY slab_key;
```
This prevents double counting if session_id repeats.

keith: good. rollout plan: 1) router patch canary to 5% for 2h (verify no latency regressions), 2) aggregator dedupe + FF for preview cap, 3) enable cap for all preview users, 4) run billing-preview diff for 7d and then consider applying to invoices only if stable.

mona: product note: include lines in billing-preview change log and a blurb in the console "what changed" modal. customers flagged by diff > 10% should get an auto-email from customer-success.

sam: dev-bot: create checklist for me+keith+ria with tests (router retry unit, aggregator dedupe unit, preview cap e2e).

dev-bot: checklist created: https://internal/tasks/RED-2401  owners: sam, keith, ria.

ria: I'll add an alert if capped routes > 0.5% of active routes after deploy and a dashboard tile showing capped credit deltas.

keith: PR soon. ping me when you need the canary token.

mona: thanks. once PRs land let's sync 10m here and I'll draft the product/CS messaging.

sam: will link PRs in thread when ready.

keith: quick note  we should also consider a long-term change: move from session_id dedupe to event-uuid idempotency at ingress so retries are inherently deduped upstream. follow-up RFC.

mona: +1 on RFC. For now do the dedupe and cap in preview.

sam: ok locking action items: keith router patch, ria aggregator dedupe + cap FF, sam preview UI badge + messaging, mona product copy.
